title: Feature Request - multiple glucose levels/settings
symptom: The user requests the ability to define more than the current three glucose ranges (low, in range, high) to have more colors on the graph, e.g., yellow for low, green for normal, orange for medium high, and red for high. They also ask if this would carry over to watch faces like Pebble.
evidence_quote: Not sure what to call it; might have to be alert levels; but maybe more a T2 than T1's add more levels, then we can have more colors on the graph.
